'''Ralthar Sitan''', known as '''Snout''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] who was kept as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] by the organization called [[the Crucible]] around the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Forced to brutal fights despite his peaceful nature, he was able to experience centuries of the Crucible's cruelty through [[Memnis|memnii]] from other [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]]. In [[3963 BBY]], on [[Volgax]], he let [[Zayne Carrick]] to see the Crucible's history through memnii, after he was defeated in the fight. However, soon the two were forced into another fight, in which Snout deliberately left a hole in his defense, allowing Carrick to kill him and stop his suffering.
